provider_claims.notes: Screeners find candidates but lack options chain data. Needs options liquidity provider.
Tax loss harvesting is operator-triggered, not screener-driven.

REPAIRED 2026-07-20. History: the previous provider (FMP v3 earning_calendar) returns HTTP 403 — "Legacy Endpoint ... only for legacy users with valid subscriptions prior August 31, 2025" — and the key is additionally quota-exhausted (429 on every FMP endpoint). The failure was SILENT (`if not resp.ok: return {}` plus a bare except), so every symbol looked like "no scheduled earnings" and the blackout gate FAILED OPEN for covered_call, cash_secured_put, credit_spread and long_call. Now: scripts/earnings_provider.py is the source of record. Primary = symbol_profiles.next_earnings_date, written daily 06:35 weekdays by scripts/earnings_enrich.py from yfinance (held stocks + Hermes top-N watchlist; 2079 profiles / 649 future-dated). Secondary = on-demand yfinance for symbols outside that coverage, so the desk can price names beyond the enriched set. Three-state contract: SCHEDULED / NONE_SCHEDULED / UNKNOWN — UNKNOWN fails CLOSED with refusal_code EARNINGS_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN and is never collapsed into "no earnings". A profile row older than EARNINGS_PROFILE_TRUST_DAYS (7) is UNKNOWN, not "none scheduled". Verified live: NOC blocked (earnings 2026-07-21), RTX blocked (2026-07-23), SCHD cleared (ETF, no issuer earnings). FMP_API_KEY is now unused by this path and may be retired.

CORRECTED 2026-07-20: was provider=NOT_CONFIGURED / BLOCKED_PROVIDER_MISSING, which had been stale since the Schwab chain went live. Verified by probe: options_lifecycle_engine.quote_leg() returned an exact-match SPY contract quote. Schwab is AUTHORITATIVE for contracts, strikes, expirations, bid/ask/mid, greeks, OI and contract volume at the execution decision timestamp. Finviz supplies NO options-chain data in this project and must never silently substitute for a failed Schwab chain.
Uses OHLC cache + RSI/Fibonacci calculations. Already partially implemented via trade_backtest_engine.py technicals.
